about: A demo brief for the Judge Protocol paymaster on Arc testnet. The two contractors are scripted agents with their own wallets; their writing is scripted in demoWork. The paymaster is the agent under test.

milestones.title: Explain ERC-8183 escrow for the docs
milestones.acceptance: Between 30 and 120 words. Must mention ERC-8183, USDC and Arc.

demoWork.draft: ERC-8183 is an escrow standard for work between agents. The client locks USDC in a job, the provider delivers, and a neutral evaluator decides whether the delivery met the criteria written into the job before the work started. A pass releases the escrow to the provider; a reject refunds the client.
demoWork.good: ERC-8183 is an escrow standard for work between agents on Arc. The client locks USDC in a job, the provider delivers, and a neutral evaluator decides whether the delivery met the criteria written into the job before the work started. A pass releases the escrow to the provider; a reject refunds the client.
demoWork.bad: Escrow for agents: the client locks funds, the provider delivers, and someone checks the work before the money moves.

milestones.title: Invoice record for the explainer
milestones.acceptance: Valid JSON with fields invoiceId, total and currency. total must be a number. currency must be a string.

milestones.title: Security review of the payment flow
milestones.acceptance: At least 60 words. Must mention reentrancy, allowance and escrow.

demoWork.draft: The flow approves an exact allowance, funds escrow once, and never calls out before state changes, so reentrancy has nothing to exploit.
demoWork.good: The payment flow approves an exact allowance for the escrow contract and funds each job once, at the price the contractor quoted, after re-reading the job on chain. It never transfers USDC to a contractor directly: only the evaluator's verdict releases the escrow. There are no external calls before state changes in the paymaster, so reentrancy has nothing to exploit, and a stale allowance can only be spent by the escrow on a job the paymaster itself funds.

milestones.title: Landing page polish
milestones.acceptance: Make the landing page look great and feel premium.
